timeline.title: Won't stop blemish formation completely
timeline.description: Blemish formation happens due to the accumulation of sweat, dirt and excess oil. While this body wash for blemish helps get rid of these, the body wash gel cannot entirely guarantee against the formation of blemish. Do note that this antibacterial body wash is a preventive measure, not a permanent solution.

howToUse: On wet skin, take some body wash on your hands or on a loofah Massage into skin using a gentle circular motion Rinse

faqs.question: Will it dry out my skin?
faqs.answer: 5% Niacinamide in this Man Matters Charcoal Body Wash helps strengthen skin's moisture barrier. This helps deep cleanse the skin without drying it out.

faqs.question: How often can I use this?
faqs.answer: We recommend using this Man Matters Charcoal Body Wash, once or twice a day based on your preference.

faqs.question: Will exfoliating my skin every day cause any harm?
faqs.answer: This is not a physical exfoliator. This Man Matters Charcoal Body Wash deep cleanses skin without tearing through the skin's barrier.

faqs.question: Will it prevent rashes and itchiness?
faqs.answer: Menthol in this Man Matters Charcoal Body Wash helps soothe skin and doesn't cause rashes.

faqs.question: Which skin type can use this?
faqs.answer: Every skin is different. We recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine.
